WHAT: App where user uploads a Pinterest/Instagram outfit photo, AI identifies clothing items, scrapes Vinted for similar pieces in user's specified size, returns buyable results.

PROJECT PATH: /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/vinted-fashion-finder/

VINTED API (unofficial, undocumented):
- Search: GET /api/v2/catalog/items — returns id, title, price, total_item_price, service_fee, brand_title, url, photo, user
- Detail: GET /api/v2/items/{id} — adds brand_id, size_id, status_id, description, color, condition, location, category
- User: GET /api/v2/users/{id} — login, item_count, feedback counts
- RISK: Unofficial, Vinted can change/block, ToS grey area

CURRENT BLOCKER: Needs Google Cloud project + authentication keys. User knows exactly what to do, cannot initiate (ADHD initiation failure, not technical uncertainty).

NOTES: Vinted has Python wrapper on PyPI (vinted-api-wrapper). EU-focused marketplace — strong Lithuania/Lithuania market fit.
